record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page at `site/public/prices.html`. It lists **6 products**, and the cheapest is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The build only lists products marked active in `data/products.json`. Four inactive ones are left out, and two of those cost less than the pencil set: Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20). They don't appear on the page.

The script has to be run from inside `site/` (`cd site && node build.js`) because it reads its files from the folder it's run in. I didn't change `build.js`.
